code.text: Dental encounter summary — to referring pediatrician

assessor.display: Dr. David Watson, DDS — Cornell Scott-Hill Health Center

summary: Timothy Jones seen 2026-05-28 per referral from Northeast Medical Group. Comprehensive oral evaluation and periodontal risk assessment completed. Gingivitis has progressed to early-stage aggressive periodontitis (K05.211), localized, slight - consistent with the accelerated periodontitis trajectory in Type 1 diabetes. Scaling and root planing performed in two quadrants (D4341 x2). Chlorhexidine chip placed at affected sites (D4381). Oral hygiene education provided to patient and grandmother (D1330); toothbrush, toothpaste, and floss dispensed. Six-month recall recommended. Permanent restoration of partially erupted lower central incisor to be monitored at recall.

note.text: Structured encounter summary returned to the referring pediatrician (Dr. Smith, NEMG) via Connie — one of two simultaneous summaries at Interaction 4 (the other goes to the endocrinologist). This summary closes the referral loop (see the completed referral Task and ServiceRequest). Transmitted as discrete FHIR, not a PDF.
